title: Trimble SketchUp SKP File Parsing Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-121741)
description: A use-after-free vulnerability in Trimble SketchUp's SKP file parsing allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as opening a malicious file or visiting a malicious page. The flaw arises from improper validation of object existence before operations, leading to code execution in the context of the current process.
